_comment: Copy to workspace/<name>/data/answer-bank.json and write every answer YOURSELF. Claude cannot write this file; it may draft entries in data/answer-bank.proposed.json from your own words for you to copy. A form question matches an entry when it equals your question or contains it (12 characters or more), so use the form's own wording. Answer a legal agreement (certification, privacy notice, arbitration) only if you mean it for every company whose form uses that wording. Entries below are placeholders.

question: I certify that the information provided in this application is true
Have you ever worked for this company before
Why are you interested in this role
answer: Your own two or three sentences.
